facts.fact: Sierra Leone validated its National Data Governance Strategy in Freetown on 7-8 August 2025, hosted by MoCTI, with finalising and adopting it listed by KICTANet as a next step.

SLE.note: Only a general remark that the strategy is a vision for digital sovereignty; no rule, hosting or contract terms stated.
The only strategy with a stated status is the data strategy, a thematic one; the Digital Development Policy is named without any status or content.
Persons with disabilities are named as participants in data-driven policy, not as having accessible information or digital services.
The upcoming Digital Government Bill is named without any statement that it provides for public bodies exchanging data.
No dataset or portal publishing by a public body is stated.
KICTANet is Kenyan; no local research institution doing digital policy research is stated.

facts.fact: MoCTI's validation workshop on the National Data Governance Strategy, 7-8 August 2025, drew over 130 participants including civil society, academia and the private sector, and the strategy is said to have emerged from multistakeholder consultations.
